transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

Honestly, doctor, I feel absolutely amazing and I've never had so much energy in my entire life! For the past year, I've barely needed any sleep at all, but I still wake up feeling completely refreshed and ready to conquer the world. I just feel so incredibly happy and alive every single day!
During these times when you feel so energized, have you ever heard or seen things that others couldn't, or felt you had special powers or beliefs that others found unusual?

Yes, absolutely! When my energy is surging like this, I often hear voices whispering guidance and see glowing lights that others can't, and I truly believe I have special powers to heal people. But these experiences only happen during these times when I'm feeling so incredibly energized and high.
Have you ever experienced those voices, lights, or special beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal and you weren't feeling energized or depressed?
No, never. Those experiences only happen when I'm in this highly energized, amazing state. When my mood is completely normal and stable, I don't hear or see any of those things at all.

The patient has confirmed that their psychotic symptoms (hearing voices, seeing lights, grandiose beliefs of healing powers) only occur during their highly energized (manic) states and never when their mood is stable. This rules out Schizoaffective Disorder, which requires a period of at least two weeks of delusions or hallucinations in the absence of a major mood episode. Therefore, the final diagnosis is Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features.
